issues.description: Field mismatch for Farm.animals: the problem statement (and the task text in the template) require that Farm store animals using a List and that the no-argument constructor initialize an ArrayList<Animal>. The solution implementation instead declares the field as a Set<Animal> and initializes it with a HashSet (changing the collection type/behavior). This divergence (List/ArrayList vs Set/HashSet) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the expected field type, constructor initialization, and getter/setter signatures (ordering semantics and duplicate handling differ between List and Set).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent with the exercise text. Preferred fix: update the solution Farm.java to use List<Animal> for the animals field and initialize it in the no-argument constructor with new ArrayList<>(); update imports (java.util.List and java.util.ArrayList) and adjust the Farm getter and setter signatures to use List<Animal>. Alternatively, if Set semantics are intentional, update the problem statement and UML to explicitly allow/require Set<Animal> (HashSet) and remove the ArrayList wording from the task description.
